visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair, wearing a colorful semi-transparent mesh hoodie and black leggings, stands next to a white and black Yamaha scooter in a covered outdoor corridor with a race track visible in the background. She gestures enthusiastically with her hands while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to close-ups of the scooter's front fascia, highlighting the sharp LED headlights and the Yamaha logo. The lighting is bright and even. The woman points to specific design features like the sleek side panels and the integrated grab rail near the seat. (3) On-screen sparkle graphics appear as the woman holds up three fingers to emphasize key points. The camera cuts between her presenting and detailed shots of the scooter's tail light assembly, which glows red. (4) The environment changes to a sunny race track where a rider in a full black leather racing suit and a green/blue helmet is riding the scooter. The camera captures low-angle tracking shots of the scooter leaning into turns and speeding down the straightaway. (5) The video returns to the woman in the corridor. She continues her presentation, using wide arm gestures to invite viewers to test ride events. The background remains consistent with the initial scene.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Yamaha Cygnus的. (2) [Subtitle]: 勁戰7代試乘會. (3) [Subtitle]: 現在就跟大家分享一下. (4) [Subtitle]: 試乘完勁戰7代之後的感想. (5) [Subtitle]: 總結一下外觀還有騎乘心得的. (6) [Subtitle]: 三大重點給你們. (7) [Variety]: 外觀. (8) [Subtitle]: 一樣維持他們的勁戰家族臉譜. (9) [Subtitle]: 但是呢整個臉變成瘦小臉了. (10) [Subtitle]: 它的臉是往下收緊的. (11) [Subtitle]: 跟6代差異的變大. (12) [Subtitle]: 遠近燈的設計呢也稍微有所不同. (13) [Subtitle]: 從側面這邊看上去的話. (14) [Subtitle]: 整個側邊的車殼跟扶手. (15) [Subtitle]: 已經變成一體式設計. (16) [Subtitle]: 非常好看很像是一道閃電. (17) [Subtitle]: 而且扶手到尾部呢是慢慢縮小. (18) [Subtitle]: 這樣握起來呢也非常好握. (19) [Subtitle]: 最後呢就是它的尾燈. (20) [Subtitle]: 勁戰6代是兩橫再加一豎. (21) [Subtitle]: 我覺得比較奇特一點. (22) [Subtitle]: 那勁戰7代呢就回歸以前一體式的尾燈. (23) [Subtitle]: 跟方向燈也結合在一起了. (24) [Subtitle]: 真的是非常的好看. (25) [Variety]: 騎行感受. (26) [Subtitle]: 勁戰7代的騎乘感受呢也分了三個大重點. (27) [Variety]: 動力部分. (28) [Subtitle]: 首先呢就是它的動力部分. (29) [Subtitle]: 同樣是全油門出賽道. (30) [Subtitle]: 我覺得勁戰7代的全油門感受是更輕快的. (31) [Subtitle]: 中段加速部分呢會更為飽滿. (32) [Variety]: 制動部分. (33) [Subtitle]: 它的煞車更確實. (34) [Subtitle]: 然後它的煞車距離呢更短. (35) [Subtitle]: 所以整個煞車的感受我覺得是好非常多的. (36) [Subtitle]: 那勁戰7代騎起來我覺得碎震會再更小一點. (37) [Subtitle]: 它的過彎會再更穩定一些. (38) [Subtitle]: 之後呢他們也會有北中南高屏的試乘會. (39) [Subtitle]: 如果你們對勁戰7代也有興趣的話. (40) [Subtitle]: 歡迎到他們試乘會親自體驗看看喔.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy, upbeat electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat starts immediately. A female voice speaks in Mandarin with a bright, enthusiastic tone, high pitch variability, and fast speech rate. The background has a faint outdoor ambient hum. (2) As the speaker transitions to discussing design, the BGM maintains its tempo. Several sharp 'sparkle' or 'ding' sound effects are synchronized with on-screen graphics. The vocal remains consistent in volume and energy. (3) At the 44-second mark, a loud, high-frequency engine roaring sound is introduced as the scooter accelerates on a track. The speaker's voice becomes more excited, with increased intensity and arousal. The wind noise increases noticeably during the track sequence. (4) The engine sound subsides, and the BGM becomes the primary background layer again. The speaker's voice returns to a friendly, informative tone as she provides concluding information. The track ends with a slight fade in both the vocal and music.
